source_text: VI. Καὶ ἐπιμενόντων τῶν ζητούντων αὐτόν, μετέβη εἰς ἕτερον ἀγρίδιον. Καὶ εὐθέως ἐπέστησαν οἱ ζητοῦντες αὐτόν. Καὶ μὴ εὑρόντες συνελάβοντο παιδάρια δύο, ὧν τὸ ἕτερον βασανιζόμενον ὡμολόγησεν. Ἦν γὰρ καὶ ἀδύνατον λαθεῖν αὐτόν, ἐπεὶ καὶ οἱ προδιδόντες αὐτὸν οἰκεῖοι ὑπῆρχον. Καὶ ὁ εἰρήναρχος, ὁ κεκληρωμένος τὸ αὐτὸ ὄνομα, Ἡρώδης ἐπιλεγόμενος, ἔσπευσεν εἰς τὸ στάδιον αὐτὸν εἰσαγαγεῖν, ἵνα ἐκεῖνος μὲν τὸν ἴδιον κλῆρον ἀπαρτίσῃ, Χριστοῦ κοινωνὸς γενόμενος, οἱ δὲ προδόντες αὐτὸν τῆς αὐτῆς τοῦ Ἰούδα τύχωσιν τιμωρίας.
pass_a_gloss: And as those who were seeking him persisted, he changed place to another small farm. And immediately those seeking him came upon it. And since they did not find him, they seized two young boys, one of whom, while being put to the question, confessed. For it was also impossible for him to escape notice, since those who were betraying him were members of the household. And the eirenarch, the one who had obtained by lot the same name, being called Herod, hastened to lead him into the stadium, in order that he on the one hand might complete his own lot, having become a sharer of Christ, and those who betrayed him on the other might obtain the same punishment as Judas.
pass_b_english: Since those hunting for him would not give up, he withdrew to another farm in the country. His pursuers arrived there at once, and when they did not find him they seized two lads, and one of them, put to torture, disclosed his whereabouts. In any case he could not remain hidden, for the men who handed him over belonged to his own household.

Then the officer charged with keeping the peace, who by lot bore the very same name, being called Herod, made haste to bring him into the stadium, so that he himself might fulfill his appointed portion by becoming a sharer with Christ, while those who betrayed him might receive the same penalty as Judas.
